claim_row.section: 06.spectral Form-degree-preserving self-adjoint weighted Hodge Dirac operator
claim_row.notes: Registered claim text: construction of the canonical weighted Hodge Dirac operator. The compiled locators are archive_weighted_hodge_dirac_owner, cubicalWeightedHodgeDirac_application, and cubicalWeightedHodgeDirac_positive_profile_application. The conditional cubical applications construct d + d†_w from the registered coboundary for caller-supplied diagonal profiles. For a strictly positive comparison profile, the new application proves positive definiteness and self-adjointness for that pairing; this profile is not the Lorentz-induced Hodge weight (whose finite exterior pairing has signature (8,8)) and is neither geometrically derived nor physically selected. The signed-profile application also proves the Hodge anticommutator square and degree preservation. The existing LEAN_PROVED and CORE-FORMALIZED labels are preserved; these locator strings and conditional results do not independently accept the registered canonical or physical properties or C0 membership.
